registered.rule: top 12 hedgeable perps by previous-30-day mean funding, held one month, delta-neutral, 20bp rebalance cost
registered.fail: mean monthly funding <= 0 net of costs over 12 months
early_kill: hedge unavailable for more than 3 of the 12 selections
not_evidence: the absence of a crisis in the sample

backtest_for_reference.caveat: Sharpe 5 and zero drawdown is what carry looks like before its tail risk appears. Treat as a warning, not an expectation.
